children: US power plant builder's fiscal Q2 revenue rose 62%, beating analyst expectations
Diluted EPS for fiscal Q2 rose to $3.76 from $2.50 a year earlier
Quarterly dividend increased to $0.50 per share
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for future quarters or the full year
POWER SEGMENT EXECUTION - Co said Power segment revenue grew 53% year-over-year to $301 mln, driven by ramp-up of construction activities on several contracts
PROJECT MIX - Co said gross margin improvement was primarily due to changing mix of projects and contract types and strong execution in Power segment
TELEDATA EXPANSION - Co said acquisition of ValCor Communications expanded geographic presence and client base in Teledata segment
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the construction & engineering peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Argan, Inc. is $700.00, about 72.9% above its September 1 closing price of $404.75
The stock recently traded at 29 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 55 three months ago
